notes: isFavorite filter exists in state but has no control.

summary: Clicking a card fetches the full capsule and opens an editor dialog. Presets open read-only with a Duplicate button. User capsules open editable with Save, Delete, and Cancel.

title: Create writing style capsule
summary: User creates a Writing capsule with name, one or more example excerpts, optional labels, negative constraints, and notes. Backend inserts a row with user_id set, library_id null, and is_preset false.

preconditions: name required, excerpts non-empty after trimming
notes: Backend requires only name and type, so an empty excerpts list is accepted by the API even though the UI blocks it.

title: Create visual style capsule with pending reference images
summary: User creates a Visual capsule with name, five design pillars (dropdowns), descriptor text, and up to 5 reference images. Images selected before save are held in memory and uploaded one by one after the capsule row is created.
entrypoint: Create Capsule then Visual Style, Create Visual Style Capsule button

notes: If an upload fails the capsule is still saved and the user gets a warning. Pillar values are not validated server-side. Preset-style pillar values can fall outside the dropdown option lists.

title: Edit user style capsule
summary: Owner edits name, excerpts, labels, constraints, notes (writing) or name, pillars, descriptor, and image list (visual). Backend rejects presets (403) and non-owners (403).
entrypoint: capsule card then edit dialog then Update Style Capsule
preconditions: capsule is not preset and user owns it
downstream: Changes future injections into LLM and image prompts with no versioning or invalidation (see V2-STATE-02)
notes: Visual edit PUTs referenceImageUrls from local state, overwriting the server array. Writing edit also sends freeformNotes undefined when blank, which the backend ignores.

title: Delete user style capsule
summary: Owner deletes a custom capsule after an AlertDialog confirmation. Presets cannot be deleted. Storage files are not removed.
entrypoint: card dropdown Delete, or Delete Capsule in editor, then confirm
notes: Functional P because FK constraints from projects, image_generation_jobs, and style_capsule_applications have no ON DELETE action, so a used capsule likely fails with 500 at runtime (inferred from schema, runtime U).

title: Toggle favorite on a capsule
summary: Heart button flips is_favorite on the capsule row. It works on presets too, and the flag is shared by every user because it is one column.
entrypoint: heart icon on capsule card (hover)
preconditions: capsule owned by user or preset
downstream: Favorites group at top of StyleCapsuleSelector (CAP-13, CAP-15)
notes: Toggling a preset favorite changes it for all users. Backend StyleCapsuleService.toggleFavorite duplicates the route logic and is not called.

title: Duplicate a preset to customize
summary: Duplicate creates a user-owned copy of a preset, named '<name> (Copy)' by default, with the same content and reference-image URLs. Only presets can be duplicated; user capsules are rejected with 404.
entrypoint: preset card dropdown Duplicate, or Duplicate to Customize in preset dialog
notes: Reference-image URLs are copied as strings, so the copy shares the preset's image files.

title: Upload reference image to existing visual capsule
summary: In edit mode, selecting an image uploads it immediately to the capsule. The server stores it in bucket style-capsule-images and appends the public URL to reference_image_urls.
entrypoint: visual capsule edit dialog, ImageUploader
preconditions: visual type, owner, PNG/JPEG/WebP, 5MB, up to 5 per batch
notes: No server-side cap on total images per capsule. Upload to a preset is refused by the type and owner checks, not by is_preset.

title: Remove reference image from visual capsule
summary: Removing an image in edit mode deletes its URL from the array by index. The file in storage is kept.
entrypoint: hover X on uploaded image in visual editor
notes: Storage object is not deleted (TODO in code, styleCapsules.ts:474-475). Functional P for that reason.

title: Preview injection text in writing editor
summary: Toggle in writing editor builds a client-side preview of the text the AI will see. The preview format differs from the backend formatter, so the preview is not an exact copy.
entrypoint: Show Preview button in writing editor
notes: Preview always prints a Style characteristics line even when empty. Backend omits empty sections. Preview is not shown for visual capsules.

preconditions: project exists or is being created
related: V1 slice for Stage1 streamline path
notes: Stage 1 autosave is off, so the selection persists only on proceed. Behavior in the streamline intake path is UNKNOWN and belongs to V1.

summary: In Stage 5 the user picks a visual capsule from the Style Capsule selector. Selecting it immediately locks the style into Stage 5 content and disables further changes until Change Style is used.
entrypoint: Stage 5 Select Visual Style, Style Capsule mode
notes: No confirmation step. Stage 5 canProceed requires isStyleLocked and images on all gate assets (Stage5Assets.tsx:218).

title: Use manual visual tone instead of capsule (Stage 5)

title: Change style: mark images as outdated
summary: Change Style opens a warning. Choosing Mark Images as Outdated sets style_outdated=true on all branch assets that have images, unlocks Stage 5 style, and clears the stored style. Images remain.
entrypoint: Stage 5 Change Style button, then Mark Images as Outdated
preconditions: style locked and stage not locked or outdated
notes: Dialog shows literal 'Style Capsule' as the current style name for capsule mode. Style outdated does not block Stage 5 completion. style_outdated is reset only on successful master-asset generation.

title: Change style: clear all images
summary: Clear All Images removes image_key_url from every branch asset that has one, resets style_outdated, and unlocks the Stage 5 style.
entrypoint: Change Style then Clear All Images
notes: Does not touch generation attempts, scene asset instances, angle variants, or location views by code inspection.

title: Visual capsule text injected into image generation (automatic)
summary: For image jobs with a capsule id, the backend loads descriptor_strings and design_pillars and joins them into one text string sent to the image model. Manual tone replaces capsule text when no capsule id is present.
entrypoint: any image job: Stage 5 generate, Stage 8 scene asset, transformation post, frame generation, global asset generate
preconditions: capsule id or manual tone on job
notes: Frame jobs do not receive the capsule because the caller query is broken (V2-FACT-02). Global asset jobs do receive it.

title: Visual capsule reference images sent to image model
summary: Capsule reference image URLs are downloaded and sent to Gemini as inline image parts, after any identity reference images. Failed downloads are skipped with a log entry.
entrypoint: same as CAP-19
notes: Capsule images are sent with no role field, which changes the prompt branch chosen by NanoBananaClient (V2-FACT-09). Functional P.

summary: Owner deletes a global asset after confirmation. Deletion is refused with 409 and project titles if any project asset still references it.
entrypoint: asset card menu Delete then confirm
notes: Storage files are not removed.

notes: V5 owns this route. Recorded here because it creates global assets. Can produce extra_archetype global assets (V2-FACT-12).

title: Seed prompt templates over HTTP (no UI caller)
summary: Any authenticated user can POST to /api/seed/prompt-templates to insert three v1.0.0 prompt templates for stages 2, 3, and 4. There is no frontend or e2e caller.
entrypoint: HTTP POST /api/seed/prompt-templates only
notes: Inserts fail silently on duplicate name and version. Functional P.

title: Scene asset and Stage 8 image generation uses Stage 5 style lock (cross-slice, V5)
summary: Stage 8 scene asset generation, edit, and transformation post image read the current Stage 5 locked capsule or manual tone, not the asset's stored capsule id.
entrypoint: Stage 8 scene asset generate, edit, transformation post
notes: Stage 5 and Stage 8 can use different capsules for the same asset (V2-STATE-01).

title: StyleCapsule (writing and visual, one table)
summary: One style_capsules row type with a type discriminator. Writing rows use example excerpts, style labels, negative constraints, and notes. Visual rows use design pillars, descriptor strings, and reference image URLs. Presets have is_preset true and user_id null.
notes: Frontend type maps camelCase; backend JSON shapes are not enforced by DB.

title: GlobalAsset (user-owned reusable asset)
summary: global_assets row per user with name, asset_type (character, prop, location, extra_archetype), description, image_prompt, image_key_url, optional visual_style_capsule_id, version, and promoted_from_project_id. Project assets clone from it through global_asset_id.
notes: Frontend type union includes extra_archetype. Create and update routes reject it.

title: Preset style capsules (system library seed)
summary: Eight presets created by the seed script: 4 writing (Hemingway Minimalist, Victorian Ornate, Hard-Boiled Noir, Whimsical Fantasy) and 4 visual (Neo-Noir, Pixar Animation, Cinema Verite, Cyberpunk Neon). They sit in a 'System Presets' library with user_id null.
notes: PRESET_CAPSULE_IDS constants are not UUIDs and are unused. Preset rows are created only by the operator script, which is not idempotent.

title: Prompt templates seeded by seed route and seed script
summary: prompt_templates rows named treatment_expansion (stage 2), beat_extraction (stage 3), and master_script_generation (stage 4), all version 1.0.0. Both seed paths write the same name and version, so only one content set is live.
notes: Which content is live is UNKNOWN; query prompt_templates to settle.

title: style_capsules, style_capsule_libraries, style_capsule_applications
summary: Three tables from migration 004 with RLS enabled. style_capsules holds both writing and visual fields. Libraries are unused for new capsules. Applications is an audit table written but never read. Projects gained writing_style_capsule_id and visual_style_capsule_id columns, never written.
notes: Migration 005 Step 4 is not valid PostgreSQL (WHERE clause on a table UNIQUE constraint). Applied state UNKNOWN.

title: global_assets
summary: Owner-scoped global asset table with RLS. Backend uses the service-role key so RLS is not the enforcement point; code filters on user_id.
notes: Global asset image jobs use image_generation_jobs with project_id null (migration 010).

title: projects capsule columns are never written
summary: projects.writing_style_capsule_id and visual_style_capsule_id are read in five backend places but no code path writes them. PUT /api/projects/:id accepts no capsule fields.
notes: Writing capsule still reaches generation through the Stage 1 fallback in ContextManager.

title: Frame jobs query nonexistent stage_states columns
summary: Frame generation routes select state_data from stage_states filtered by project_id, but stage_states has neither column. The query errors and the visual capsule id is always undefined for frame image jobs.
notes: Query error handling is not read in detail; the undefined result is the inferred outcome, runtime U.

title: Capsule deletion is blocked by FK constraints once used
summary: projects, image_generation_jobs, and style_capsule_applications reference style_capsules with no ON DELETE action, so deleting a used capsule should fail.
notes: Runtime behavior UNKNOWN; settle by deleting a used capsule in a test database.

title: Capsule list omits content fields
summary: GET /api/style-capsules and the selector data path select only id, name, type, favorite, preset flag, and timestamps. Card bodies and selector previews that read labels, excerpts, pillars, descriptors, or images render empty.
notes: Detail fetch returns full rows, so the detail dialog works.

title: Libraries are auto-created and unused
summary: GET /libraries/all inserts a default library named 'My Style Capsules' for any user without one. New capsules always have library_id null. Frontend createLibrary has no caller. Backend StyleCapsuleService library methods are not called.
notes: VisualStyleCapsuleEditor accepts a libraries prop and never uses it.

title: Presets are immutable through the API
summary: PUT and DELETE return 403 for presets. POST favorite and POST duplicate accept presets. Presets are created only by the operator seed script.
notes: Favorite toggle on a preset is shared by all users (V2-FACT-07). The service-layer check is never reached because routes do their own checks.

title: Favorites are a single shared column
summary: is_favorite lives on the capsule row, so any user toggling a preset favorite changes the value for everyone. There is no per-user favorites table.
notes: Design contradiction with a per-user favorites UI.

title: Capsule reads have no ownership check in generation paths
summary: getVisualStyleContext and assetExtractionService.getStyleContext read any capsule by id with service role. /api/assets/:id/generate-image and /api/images/generate accept any visualStyleCapsuleId from the body. A user who knows another user's capsule UUID can use its text and images.
notes: Exploitability depends on learning a UUID; no test covers it.

title: NanoBanana prompt branch depends on role-less capsule images
summary: Capsule reference images carry no role field. With two or more capsule images and no identity refs, the legacy branch tells the model the first style image is the subject. With identity refs plus capsule images, the identity-only branch counts only identity images. The capsule images are attached unlabeled.
notes: Behavior is from code reading; actual model output is UNKNOWN.

title: Style capsule application log is write-only
summary: Each Stage 2, 3, or 4 save with a capsule id inserts a style_capsule_applications row with injection context (stage, template, length, trace id). Nothing reads it. Capsule content is not snapshotted.
notes: Frontend stores the metadata under _styleCapsuleMetadata during save.

title: Frontend capsule code calls methods that do not exist
summary: beatService.regenerateBeats calls styleCapsuleService.formatWritingStyleInjection, which the frontend service does not define, so the TypeError is caught and the variable is empty. Orphaned imageService calls recordApplication, also undefined.
notes: Backend overrides the empty value through llm.ts path 1, so the effect on output is small.

title: extra_archetype global assets crash the card and cannot be edited
summary: Promote can create extra_archetype global assets. AssetCard has no config for that type, so rendering crashes on config.icon. PUT and POST reject that type.
notes: Crash is inferred from code; runtime UNKNOWN.

title: Sync from global ignores overridden_fields
summary: sync-from-global force-overwrites name, description, image prompt, image, and capsule, then clears those names from overridden_fields. Migration 009 documents overridden_fields as protecting fields from global sync.
notes: Code comments say the force sync is intentional.

title: Promote does not link project asset to global asset
summary: promote inserts a global_assets row with promoted_from_project_id but never sets global_asset_id on the project asset. Repeated promotes create duplicates.

title: Two seed paths write the same prompt template keys
summary: seed route and seed-templates script both insert name and version pairs that are unique. Whichever runs first wins; the other's inserts fail and are logged and swallowed.
notes: Live content UNKNOWN.

title: Seeded templates lack regeneration_guidance placeholder
summary: Callers send regeneration_guidance for regenerate calls, but seeded templates have no such placeholder. Interpolation replaces only placeholders that are present, so guidance never reaches the model with seeded templates. llm.ts also adds beat_sheet_reference, which seeded templates also lack.
notes: Cross-slice to V1 regeneration path. Live template content UNKNOWN.

title: Visual capsule UI label in Change Style dialog is a constant
summary: Change Style dialog shows literal 'Style Capsule' as the current style name, not the capsule's name.

title: Global asset capsule cannot be cleared and version bumps on every save
summary: Clearing the capsule selector sends undefined, which the PUT handler ignores. Every PUT and every image upload or generation increments version, which marks clones as outdated.
entrypoint: AssetDialog Update Asset

title: StyleCapsuleService class is mostly dead code
summary: Only getCapsuleById and formatWritingStyleInjection are called. Other methods (create, update, delete, favorite, duplicate, libraries, application log, visual formatter) duplicate route logic and are never called. Several require a library that routes do not supply.

title: Style capsule router mounted at /api/style-capsules
summary: Eleven endpoints mounted behind authenticateUser. Listed in the next entries.
notes: Routes: GET /, GET /:id, POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/favorite, POST /:id/duplicate, POST /:id/upload-image, DELETE /:id/images/:imageIndex, GET /libraries/all, POST /libraries.

title: POST /api/style-capsules
summary: Creates a user capsule. Requires name and type (writing or visual); type-specific fields are copied from body. Sets library_id null and is_preset false.

title: PUT /api/style-capsules/:id
summary: Updates owned non-preset capsule. Rejects presets with 403 and non-owners with 403. Maps camelCase body fields to snake_case, including libraryId which the UI never sends.

title: POST /api/style-capsules/:id/upload-image
summary: Multipart image upload, 5MB max, PNG/JPEG/WebP, visual capsules only, owner only. Stores file in bucket style-capsule-images and appends its public URL.

title: GET /api/style-capsules and GET /api/style-capsules/:id
summary: List returns owned plus preset capsules with partial fields. Detail returns the full row for owned or preset capsules.

title: POST /api/style-capsules/:id/favorite and /:id/duplicate
summary: Favorite toggles the shared column for owned or preset capsules. Duplicate copies a preset into a user capsule and refuses non-presets with 404.

title: DELETE /api/style-capsules/:id and DELETE /:id/images/:imageIndex
summary: Delete removes an owned non-preset capsule (no storage cleanup). Image delete removes one URL from the array by index, leaving the file in storage.

title: Global asset router /api/assets (7 endpoints)
summary: GET /, GET /:id, POST /, PUT /:id, DELETE /:id, POST /:id/upload-image, POST /:id/generate-image. Every query filters by authenticated user_id. Generate-image uses the body capsule id or the asset's stored id.
notes: Multer limit 10MB and types PNG/JPEG/WebP.

title: GET /api/images/jobs/:jobId (V5, used by global asset polling)
summary: Returns job status after checking ownership through project or global asset. Used by global asset AI generation polling.
notes: Cross-slice to V5 (images.ts).

title: POST /api/seed/prompt-templates
summary: Inserts three prompt templates. Any authenticated user can call it. No tests and no UI caller.

title: Cross-slice project asset routes that touch global assets and capsules (V5)
summary: POST mark-style-outdated and clear-all-images for Stage 5, POST clone-from-global, POST sync-from-global, POST promote, and GET version-sync-status. These are V5-owned and recorded here for cross-reference.

title: Visual style lock and style_outdated transitions
summary: Stage 5 style is locked (capsule id or manual tone) in stage content. Change Style moves to unlocked and either marks assets style_outdated (images kept) or clears images. Assets keep their snapshotted capsule id, so they can diverge from the current lock.
trigger: Stage 5 lock, Change Style then Mark Outdated, Change Style then Clear All Images, or successful master asset generation
precondition: Stage 5 style locked and stage not locked or outdated for Change Style
side_effects: project_assets.style_outdated set true or image_key_url null; stage 5 content cleared of style keys; asset capsule ids unchanged
invalidates: style_outdated flag on project assets (advisory only); images when cleared
preserves: asset descriptions, asset capsule ids, scene asset images, generation attempts
ui_signal: Style Outdated badge; Change Style dialog; Stage 5 Select Visual Style locked badge
notes: Stage 5 and Stage 8 can use different capsules for the same asset. style_outdated is reset only on master_asset success.

title: Capsule content edit has no invalidation
summary: Editing a capsule's text, pillars, or images updates the shared row. Previously generated text and images stay as they were. Future generations use the new content. No application snapshot is stored.
side_effects: style_capsules row updated; no other table touched
preserves: all previously generated text, images, and prompts
notes: Application log stores only length and ids.

title: Presets are read-only for users
summary: Presets cannot be edited or deleted through the API and are created only by the operator script. Favorite and duplicate are the only user actions allowed on them.
trigger: PUT or DELETE on a capsule
notes: Favorite can still be toggled by any user on a preset (V2-FACT-07).
